name: CodWiki site icon
decision: The interlocked CW identifies CodWiki directly, retains a clear silhouette at 16 and 32 pixels, and matches the established charcoal-and-gold palette. The skull contains more small details; the waypoint reads more like an alien face.
processing: Only Lanczos resizing and PNG/ICO encoding were applied to the selected generated source; no manual drawing or retouching.

concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: a real website favicon and app icon for CodWiki, a Call of Duty Zombies guide and map companion. Create ONE polished icon, not a presentation or mockup. Concept A: an extremely simple angular zombie skull emblem, with its chunky open outer silhouette subtly reading as a letter C. Large angular eye sockets and a tiny number of broad jaw cuts; bold geometric masses, balanced negative space. Subject fills about 78 percent of a square canvas and is perfectly centered. Two flat colors only: warm gold #E0B45D emblem on solid charcoal #1C1F23 filling the entire square. Clean flat vector-like raster, perfectly crisp silhouette, no distress, no texture, no shading, no thin lines, no circular border, no glow. Designed to remain identifiable when reduced to 16 by 16 pixels. Original design, no existing franchise logos, no weapons, no blood, no words, no caption, no watermark.
